decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient spells and creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It includes a mix of burn spells, creatures with prowess abilities, and cards that help with card selection and digging for more threats. The objective is to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan, ultimately finishing them off with a burst of direct damage. The deck aims to close out games quickly and efficiently through fast-paced aggression and smart decision-making.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly attacking the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride, while also using burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Lightning Bolt to deal direct damage. The deck also includes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ranger-Captain of Eos to support the aggro strategy by boosting creatures and searching for key cards. The mana base is carefully constructed with fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana needed for the deck's spells and abilities. By combining strong creatures with efficient removal and support cards, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures and control spells, aiming to dominate the late game with high impact threats and disruption. The combination of ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple, along with control cards like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble, provides a strong balance of acceleration and protection. By using Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, as well as powerful spells like Ugin's Labyrinth and Kozilek's Command, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its big threats and versatile control options.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays combined with flickering effects to create powerful synergies and disrupt opponents. It utilizes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Solitude for control and protection, while also employing creatures like Witch Enchanter and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd for aggression. The blink effects from cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp provide additional value by reusing enter-the-battlefield abilities and removing threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive tactics.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The main strategy is to play creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Scion of Draco, and Territorial Kavu to deal damage quickly, while also using spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push to remove any threats on the opponent's side of the board. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide additional support to keep the pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and relentless in its attacks to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a diverse collection of creatures that can be searched for and put into play using various combo pieces like Green Sun's Zenith. By utilizing cards like Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies, the deck can generate infinite mana and use it to play powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth to overwhelm the opponent. Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Nature's Rhythm provide additional support for the combo strategy, while Leyline of Abundance and Agatha's Soul Cauldron help ensure the deck can consistently find the pieces it needs to win.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Faithful Mending, while utilizing instant speed interaction like Ephemerate and Force of Negation to protect the combo. A combination of control elements such as Thoughtseize and Teferi, Time Raveler help to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Solitude and Prismatic Ending for removal and disruption, creating a flexible and resilient strategy that aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while controlling the board.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through the use of ritual spells, mana-generating artifacts, and storm spells. It aims to cast spells like Grapeshot multiple times in a single turn, dealing massive damage to the opponent. It also utilizes cards like Past in Flames to recur spells from the graveyard and maintain a high spell count. The inclusion of Ral, Monsoon Mage and Wrenn's Resolve provides additional flexibility and utility in managing mana and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to create a powerful storm combo to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly.

This deck focuses on using ramp spells to quickly accelerate mana production in order to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. The deck also includes control elements such as counterspells and removal to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats while controlling the board and protecting your key creatures. The combination of ramp, control, and powerful Eldrazi creatures makes this deck a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a combination of creatures that can quickly apply pressure on the opponent, along with spells that provide control and disruption. The key strategy revolves around efficiently deploying threats such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco while using cards like Quantum Riddler and Leyline Binding to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of counterspells like Stubborn Denial and removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending allows for flexibility in dealing with threats and maintaining tempo. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent through a combination of speed and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the synergy between Basking Broodscale, Glaring Fleshraker, and Blade of the Bloodchief to generate a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm your opponent. The deck includes support cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Malevolent Rumble to control the board and disrupt your opponent's strategy. With cards like Ancient Stirrings and Urza's Saga, you can search for the key pieces of your combo while also ramping up your mana production. Overall, the deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to secure victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan and controlling the board using a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and graveyard hate. It also utilizes creatures with powerful abilities like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Quantum Riddler to generate card advantage and apply pressure. The key strategy is to survive the early game using counterspells and removal, then stabilize the board with powerful creatures and card advantage engines to outvalue the opponent and ultimately control the game to victory.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast creatures and direct damage spells. With creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, along with powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Voice of Victory, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total while maintaining pressure on the board. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Seasoned Pyromancer provides additional utility and ways to deal damage. The deck seeks to win the game quickly through aggressive creatures and efficient spells.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to control the board by using cards like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict to deal with threats while maintaining card advantage with cards like Wan Shi Tong, Librarian and Snapcaster Mage. By utilizing a mix of reactive and proactive spells, along with land destruction from Field of Ruin, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a longer game.

This deck revolves around assembling the Allosaurus Combo, which involves using cards like Neoform and Eldritch Evolution to cheat out Allosaurus Rider from the deck. By sacrificing creatures and paying life, the deck can quickly get out big creatures like Ghalta or Griselbrand to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes protection spells like Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. Control elements like Endurance and Consign to Memory help to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining the combo's momentum.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride, while using removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to control the board. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and versatile creatures like Ranger-Captain of Eos. Additionally, it runs disruptive cards like Blood Moon to disrupt opponents' strategies. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal, and disruption, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents and secure a fast victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.
